q1_roleAndPermFiles.findings: ACG (.role.json / .perm.json) is an OSE/webOS 5+ feature. Commercial webOS TV 4 sideloaded packages ignore these files in /var/luna/preferences/ or app root. Sideloaded services run as non-system bus clients.

q2_lunaServiceBusType.findings: Service registers with webOS 4 PalmBusService / luna-service2 client library. Runs on the private bus under app sandbox uid/gid, not as a root daemon.

q3_callerIdentification.findings: LS2 provides caller metadata on incoming message wrappers (msg.applicationId, msg.sender). Verified implementation extracts msg.applicationId with fallback to msg.sender or msg.uniqueToken.

q4_unauthorizedAccessPotential.findings: Other third-party apps or rogue services on LS2 could send request to com.lennylxx.iptv.service without validation. Mitigated with strict caller verification whitelist.

q5_tokenExposureImpact.findings: Exposing setupToken and pairingCode on Luna bus was unnecessary; app only requires appToken for API authentication. Excluded completely from Luna responses.

q6_secretLoggingInApp.findings: Line 564 of src/app.ts logged raw JSON stringified response including all tokens. Replaced with boolean and numeric flags.

q7_pinBruteForceFeasibility.findings: 10,000 combinations without global lock or rotation vulnerable to coordinated LAN enumeration. Mitigated with 20-attempt global lockout with immediate PIN destruction and rotation, timing-safe string comparison, and 15-minute TTL.

frenteC_secretLoggingHygiene.replacementFormat: log.info('Bundled service start onSuccess: running=' + running + ', port=' + p + ', hasToken=' + Boolean(token))

verificationGates.testsFailureReason: Windows host environment specific (POSIX mode 0o600, range mock socket, path separator)
